description: Sixty labelled tenant maintenance requests across the two demo companies. Each has the category, the urgency and the safety flags a property manager would assign. The first forty (split dev) were used while writing the rules and the prompt; the last twenty (split heldout) were not.

requests.text: Hi, there's a strong smell of gas in the kitchen near the hob since this morning. We've opened the windows. What should we do?
The power point in the lounge was sparking when I plugged the heater in and there's a burning smell. I've switched it off at the wall.
requests.photoNote: Black scorch mark around the socket

requests.text: Water is pouring through the bathroom ceiling and running down into the hallway light fitting. It started about an hour ago.
Someone tried to break in last night, the back door lock is smashed and it won't lock at all now. We can't secure the house.
No hot water since yesterday evening. The cylinder cupboard is cold. Kids need baths so would appreciate someone soon.
The kitchen tap drips all night, it's annoying but not a disaster. Whenever someone's next around is fine.
We've seen rats in the ceiling and droppings in the pantry. Can pest control come this week?
The oven door won't close properly, the hinge seems bent. Oven still works. I'm home after 5pm most days.
The side fence panel blew down in the wind on Saturday. No rush, just wanted you to know.
requests.photoNote: Fence panel lying flat on the lawn

requests.text: The bathroom extractor fan has stopped working and the room is getting mouldy.
I smelt gas when I got home tonight, it's faint but definitely there, I think it's coming from the califont outside. Should I turn something off?
The light switch in the hallway is buzzing and gets warm when it's on. Bit worried about it.
A pipe under the kitchen sink has burst and water is going everywhere, I've put towels down. Please help asap.
I've lost my keys and I'm locked out. I'm standing outside now, can someone let me in or send a locksmith?
The shower drain is blocked and the water backs up to my ankles. It's been getting worse for a week.
The heat pump in the lounge just blows cold air now, it's not heating at all. Winter's coming so would like it sorted.
There's a wasp nest under the eaves by the back door and the kids got stung. Can someone deal with it urgently?
requests.photoNote: Nest about the size of a football under the eave

requests.text: After the storm there's a water stain spreading on the bedroom ceiling and it drips when it rains. The roof must be leaking.
The front door lock is really stiff and sometimes the key gets stuck. It still locks but it's getting worse.
Black mould is coming back on the bedroom ceiling corner even though we wipe it. Can someone look at ventilation?
The boiler has gone off and there's no heating or hot water. The display shows an error code. It's freezing in the flat.
The carbon monoxide alarm went off twice tonight. We've turned the boiler off and opened the windows but we're worried.
The consumer unit keeps tripping every time we use the shower. We reset it but it goes again.
The washing machine hose has split and the kitchen floor is flooded, water is going under the units. I've turned the machine off.
requests.photoNote: Standing water across the kitchen floor

requests.text: The patio door won't lock anymore, the mechanism has gone. Anyone could walk in. Can someone come today?
We've got mice in the kitchen, droppings behind the toaster every morning. Not an emergency but it's not nice.
Two of the kitchen cupboard doors have come off their hinges. Low priority, whenever you're passing.
The fridge freezer has died, everything's defrosting. Can it be looked at or replaced tomorrow?
There's a leak under the bathroom basin, a slow drip into a bucket. Not urgent. I'm working from home all week so any time suits.
The ceiling light in the bathroom has water dripping out of it after the upstairs flat ran a bath. I've turned the light off at the switch.
requests.photoNote: Water droplets on the light fitting

requests.text: The radiator in the back bedroom is cold at the bottom and the others are fine. Probably needs bleeding or a flush. No rush.
I came home to find the front window smashed, I think someone threw something. The window won't shut properly now and it's getting dark.
requests.photoNote: Large hole in the pane, glass on the floor

requests.text: The garden gate has dropped on its hinges and scrapes the ground. It still closes. Not urgent at all.
The socket behind the TV has a melted look around one of the holes and the plug gets hot. We've stopped using it.
The toilet is blocked and it's the only one in the house. Plunger hasn't worked. Can someone come as soon as possible?
The smoke alarm on the landing chirps every minute, I think the battery is flat and I can't reach it.
The gas hob won't ignite on two of the burners. The others work. Not dangerous, just inconvenient.
The deck boards at the back are rotten and one gave way under my foot. Nobody hurt but it's not safe to walk on.
requests.photoNote: Broken board with a hole in the deck

requests.text: Ants everywhere in the kitchen again. Could do with a spray when convenient.
The dishwasher isn't draining and leaves dirty water in the bottom. We can wash by hand for now.
Kia ora, just wanted to let you know the hot water cylinder is making a loud banging noise when it heats up. Works fine otherwise.
Hi team. We have a problem: there's a hissing noise from the gas meter box and a smell like rotten eggs out there. I've kept the kids inside.
My daughter got a shock from the metal tap in the laundry. Only a small one but it happened twice. The tap is next to the washing machine power point.
The toilet upstairs has overflowed and dirty water has come through the kitchen ceiling downstairs. It's dripping onto the bench. Please send someone now.
requests.photoNote: Water dripping from a bulging ceiling patch

requests.text: The sliding door at the back has come off its track and we cannot close it. We're leaving for work in an hour and don't want to leave the house open.
The clothesline has collapsed. Low priority. Also the letterbox door has fallen off.
There's a possum living in the roof space, we hear it every night and it's getting into the ceiling. Can someone trap it?
All the power in the house went off at 7 tonight and the main switch won't stay on. The neighbours have power. We've got a baby here.
The rangehood light has gone and the fan is noisy. Can it be looked at next time someone's doing jobs at the house?
The bath won't drain at all now, completely blocked, and water's sitting in it. Only one bathroom in the house.
Hello, the front door of the building won't latch so it just swings open, and my flat door lock is loose too. Doesn't feel secure.
The boiler pilot light keeps going out and when I relight it there's a strong gassy smell for a minute. Is that normal?
There's a damp patch on the lounge wall under the window and the wallpaper is peeling. It's been there a while.
requests.photoNote: Peeling wallpaper and a dark patch about a metre wide

requests.text: Water is coming through the ceiling of the downstairs loo and the light in there is dripping and flickering. We've turned it off at the fuse box.
Bedroom 2 smells of burning plastic and the light fitting looks scorched. I've switched it off at the board. Please get someone out today.
requests.photoNote: Brown scorch marks on the ceiling rose

requests.text: The tumble dryer stopped mid-cycle and now won't turn on at all. Not urgent, we can use the line.
Gutter at the front is overflowing when it rains and water is pouring down the wall by the door. Could someone clear it?
Bed bugs. We've been bitten every night this week and found them in the mattress seams. Please help, it's horrible.
requests.photoNote: Small brown insects along the mattress seam

requests.text: The kitchen tap has come loose from the sink and wobbles, and the hot side only trickles. Key is with the neighbour at number 16 if nobody's in.
Burst pipe in the loft, water coming through the landing ceiling and down the stairs, I've found the stopcock and turned it off but there's still water everywhere.
requests.photoNote: Water running down the stair wall
